stumbles.quote: The game sets its straight-ahead position from how you hold the phone when the start lights go out.
stumbles.why: Start lights haven't been introduced and it's unclear when they appear. Also, the phone is said to be held in portrait on the first screen but landscape later, so it's unclear which orientation applies.

stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait. The game asks for landscape itself, with a prompt to turn the phone when it is time, so automatic rotation would get in the way.
stumbles.why: It's hard to see how a portrait lock lets you turn to landscape. The text doesn't say whether the game forces landscape or whether you rotate manually. This seems to conflict with the Calibration instruction to turn the phone to landscape.

stumbles.quote: When the game prompts you to turn the phone, turn it to landscape and hold it in your normal driving position.
stumbles.why: It conflicts with the portrait lock, since a locked phone won't rotate. 'Normal driving position' is also vague, and the text doesn't say how to hold the phone or which way to turn it.

stumbles.quote: Top of the phone away from you
stumbles.why: In landscape the 'top' of the phone is ambiguous, and it isn't clear whether it means the top edge or the edge facing away. It also leaves out whether the tilt is relative to the calibrated position.
These track names are given without explanation, which is minor. The text also doesn't say what the difficulty levels are or how to start the race after the options.

point: Open the game on a phone with a motion sensor, lock portrait, allow motion access, pick options, then turn to landscape and tilt to steer, accelerate and brake, with your hold position at the start-light moment taken as neutral.
